_doc: docs/edges.md. Edge treatments along lines (a named road or path, inside a box, from the end nearest `start`): spans of presets from levels/edge_library.json, each from the point nearest `from` to the point nearest `to` along the line, `sea` the side the sea is on walking it. tools/structures.py writes the shore_path line; the editor overrides a line by id in authored.json `edges` (its whole span list).

library._doc: docs/edges.md. The edge library, shared by every level: parts (one kind of thing that runs along an edge: a wall, a cap, a railing, a fence, edging stones, boulders, a shrub row, a feature boulder) and presets (a named mix of parts for the sea side and the land side of a line, from a photograph). A new part is one entry here; it appears in every preset picker. Parts are drawn by EDGES (src/roads.js) (build: wall | blocks | rail | scatter | single); a part with `model` uses the manifest model of that id when Assets has one, and its `build` until then. Materials name textures already in the repo (Matt, 19 Oct).
